The 422 "No commits between main and label-coverage" is the expected result of this task's design, not a lost commit or an auth fault.
Decision record D1 and the scope line say the run edits no file: the labels live in the hub's _board/_lym/config/board.yaml, outside the worktree, and the parent applies them with lym config board --set.
The writer's summary (_lym/landing/summary.md) says the parent added 22 labels, and `lym board labels` now lists all of them (tender, hibernate, drift, darn, arbiter, landing, cleanup, termwindow, logger, git, cwd, friction, lenses, reconcile, preflight, parsers, process, fsutil, cli, pawl, lint, profiles), each naming its packages.
main, label-coverage and origin/main all sit at 9c23208e, and the worktree is clean, so the task's work is done and there is no change to open a pull request for.
A plain re-launch re-runs PR-Review on the same branch and gets the same 422.
A goto can only name a row at or before PR-Review, and re-running Darn-Write would again produce no commit by design.
No repair verb this run allows moves past PR-Review or closes the run without a pull request, so this needs the parent.
